Class RegionPack

java.lang.Object
org.roux.spill.RegionPack
@Component public class RegionPack extends Object
The RegionPack is the random-access pages.bin file for one region. Slot P starts at P times the page size from the settings. publishPage(String, Page) writes the used bytes, pads to the alignment, and forces the channel. The page stays mapped. One channel stays open per region. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#RegionPack roux-v1.md

    • tryLock

      public boolean tryLock(String regionId)
      The method tries to take an exclusive lock on .lock. A lock this process already holds returns true. The directory is created when it is absent. An overlapping lock returns false. A lock that another process holds returns false. An input-output error returns false.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the folder name.
      Returns:
      The flag is true when this process holds the lock.

    • unlock

      public void unlock(String regionId)
      The method releases the exclusive lock. A region with no lock is left unchanged. An error while releasing or closing is ignored.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the folder name.

    • wipePack

      public void wipePack(String regionId)
      The method deletes pages.bin, manifest.bin, and manifest.bin.tmp. The directory stays. The lock stays. The open pack channel is closed first. An input-output error is ignored.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the folder name.

    • slotOffset

      public long slotOffset(int pageId)
      The method returns the file offset of one page slot. The offset is the page id times the page size from the settings.
      Parameters:
      pageId - The page id is the slot number.
      Returns:
      The offset is the first byte of that slot.

    • publishPage

      public void publishPage(String regionId, Page page) throws IOException
      The method writes one page into its slot. A page with no mapped bytes throws IOException with page has no RAM segment. The checksum is written first. The used bytes are padded up to the alignment, and not past the page size. A missing spill block, or an alignment of 1 or less, uses 4096. The channel is forced. The page stays mapped. A write that returns a negative count throws IOException with pack write EOF. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#RegionPack roux-v1.md spillover-semantics.md
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the folder name.
      page - The page is the page with a live segment.
      Throws:
      IOException - The page has no mapped bytes, or the write failed.

    • readRange

      public byte[] readRange(String regionId, int pageId, int offsetInPage, int length) throws IOException
      The method copies a range from one slot onto the heap. A short read leaves the unread tail as zeros.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the folder name.
      pageId - The page id is the slot number.
      offsetInPage - The offset is the first byte inside the page.
      length - The length is the number of bytes to copy.
      Returns:
      The array is the heap copy.
      Throws:
      IOException - The read failed.

    • deleteRegion

      public void deleteRegion(String regionId)
      The method closes the pack channel, releases the lock, and deletes the region directory. A missing directory returns without an error. An input-output error is ignored.
